description: §14.8.9 S441 fix round (F3) — a NULL-BODY author Response (so not E-PROTECT-005, and not refused at runtime) whose `Location` header is built from the protected column. Response headers are egress: E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: MEASURED on the first S441 cut (g-protected-column-escapes-redaction-as-scalar, security review F3): only the Response BODY was checked, so this compiled and served 302 with the hash in the Location header. §14.8.9 (S441 amendment): sinks include "every argument of an author-built Response — its body AND its init".
